analysis.narrative:
📊 **Consensus:** Cautiously bullish with medium conviction. Market exhibits bifurcated structure favoring mega-cap technology and blockchain infrastructure while cyclical consumer sectors show weakness. Competing forces between long-term AI/crypto adoption narratives and near-term macro headwinds (real rates, retail participation collapse) suggest consolidation with selective upside.

📈 **Themes:** (1) AI/robotics transformation and institutional adoption driving mega-cap strength, (2) Cryptocurrency regulatory clarity and blockchain infrastructure positioning, (3) Macro friction from real rate trajectory and Fed policy uncertainty creating rotation away from consumer discretionary into technology.
